name: Hornero Moon Phase
description: Moon Phase: desktop widget and bar indicator for the approximate moon phase and illumination from the 1.x synodic approximation, plus Desktop Widgets 2.0 size classes, per-display slot display and hide-with-restore. Always labelled approximate.
author: HorneroOS contributors

changelog.notes: Desktop Widgets 2.0 (#32): desktop surface redeclared on the same entrypoint alongside the bar surface, read-only Desktop.position slot and display shown in a host-owned popover, persisted compact/standard/wide size class and hide-with-restore visibility as typed settings (defaults standard/visible, so 2.0 content is unchanged; the bar surface is untouched), and reset for size and visibility. Moving stays in Control Center: PluginKit has no slot setter.

Weather & Astronomy 2.0: same synodic approximation as 1.x, plus derived next new/full moon countdowns, illumination progress, contextual bar indicator, configurable density, typed settings, host-context layout and Spanish catalog. No PluginKit facade exposes lunar data; every value stays labelled approximate.
Desktop widget showing the current moon phase name and approximate illumination from a pure-JS synodic approximation anchored on the 2000-01-06 new moon.

showIllumination.description: Show the approximate illumination percentage (the 1.x behaviour).

showAge.description: Show the approximate moon age in days (the 1.x behaviour).

showNextPhases.description: Show approximate days to the next new and full moons, derived from the same synodic approximation.

dataDensity.description: compact shows only the phase name; standard keeps the 1.x rows; detailed adds the approximation note.

sizeClass.description: Desktop widget size class within the host width cap (300 logical px today); standard keeps the 2.0 size. This sizes content, not the slot.

showOnDesktop.description: Show the widget content on the desktop (the 2.0 behaviour). Off leaves a visible Show widget button so the content can always be restored.
